source_scope_note: Retained original mathematical generator creates full playful batch; no new synthesis performed in audio-only packaging. Integrate ONLY the four listed audio cues.
provenance: Original procedural sound synthesis and original vector shapes for Michael Dicker. No downloaded art/audio, existing character costume or reference melody. No public-release/licence grant implied.
format: App copies:PCM16 mono48kHz. Masters:IEEE float32 mono48kHz.

sounds.description: Sustained curious contact tone; native sample loop at 0..2.8s, external gain ramps only

loop_qa.loop_endpoint_note: Last sample is NOT forced to zero: it is the correct pre-wrap waveform sample. Use uncompressed PCM buffer looping, not repeated ended/restart calls. No baked fade/silent tail.

mix_policy.during_one_shot: Duck bed smoothly by about9dB (gain0.35) over100–150ms, then restore without restarting phase. Alternatively crossfade from bed to one-shot and back; never layer independent full-level cues.
mix_policy.retrigger: Bed uses one native loop source per contact, never pointermove/ended restarts; one-shots gated at least900ms apart.
